title: Volume 1 Chapter 8: The Potential of Non-Attribute 2
content: With sparkling eyes, May looked delighted at the reforms in Corias Territory, her face filled with hope.
It was clear that she truly loved the town. Krush, as if in agreement, wore a determined expression.
It was Lady Rana and Lady Freina who made me the vice-captain of the Fourth Knight Order, even though I can't use magic due to being No Attribute.
Therefore, I must master the sword and become strong to repay them.
As Krush declared this, I couldn't help but think of ways I could support her.
"May, could you stop for a moment?"
"Is something wrong? Do you need to use the restroom?"
May teased me a little, and I gave her a wry smile. She was probably trying to lighten the atmosphere in her own way.
However, since our conversation was going off track, I decided to give them a brief lecture.
This was something I often did with Cynthia and Asha as well.
"Listen, okay? In this world, attributes have a certain degree of absolute superiority and inferiority."
"What's with the sudden seriousness?"
"Just hear me out for a bit. May, could you show us Wind Magic?"
"Sure!"
After glancing at Krush, May conjured wind and shot it like an arrow.
"《Wind Arrow》!"
Right.
Wind magic is one of the four elemental types, considered basic and powerful.
However, it can't enhance fire or shoot water, and it falls short against earth.
As I pointed out the compatibility with other elements, May pouted.
Wind attribute is also good at abilities like lightening oneself or increasing accuracy by riding the wind with arrows!
"That's true. While attributes are about magic, they can also be used as abilities as a byproduct!"
I raised my hand to stop May from arguing and continued.
"However, by enhancing abilities, you can create a tornado with enough power to blow everything away."
When I explained it was a matter of skill level, it seemed May understood.
But hearing about the power of wind made Krush's expression darken.
"Krush."
"What are you trying to say, Lord Salt?"
"I had a friend who was No Attribute."
"A friend with No Attribute?"
Indeed, while No Attribute is rare, it's not as scarce as Holy Attribute.
It's not surprising if such a person exists, right?
Both of them nodded at my words.
"And that friend was a high-ranking adventurer."
"A high-ranking adventurer despite being No Attribute?"
May exclaimed in surprise. Krush looked at me seriously.
According to him, No Attribute means being untainted by anything.
And Krush, you once said you would cut down both monsters and magic.
"Yeah, I said that."
"That's what's strange."
"What?"
Krush tilted her head, not understanding.
"May, shoot your wind magic at me."
"What! That's dangerous!"
"Just do it. I'll use Holy Attribute magic too."
"Understood."
As May used her wind magic, I slashed at it with a dagger without using any magic.
The wind magic could be cut, but it dispersed and came straight at me.
"Ugh!"
"Lord Salt!"
"I'm fine. I can cast Healing Magic on myself."
I applied Healing Magic to the wound I received from May's wind blade and looked at Krush.
"Did you see that, Krush?"
"See what?"
Just now, I cut the wind blade with a weapon imbued with magic power.
But I couldn't cut it completely.
If it had been Death Magic, I could have cut it entirely.
I've experienced that many times.
But with other attribute magic, it's even difficult to cancel it out.
I fully healed my wound and stood up.
"Now, I'm going to unleash Holy Attribute magic at you, Krush. Try to cut it."
"...Understood."
Krush drew her sword and infused it with magic power.
A colorless magic power, different from any attribute, enveloped her sword as she sliced through the bluish-white Holy Attribute arrow I released.
She cleanly cut through the magic power.
"What does this mean?"
No Attribute means untainted by anything.
That means you have no weaknesses.
It means Krush possesses an attribute that no one else has.
No Attribute can cut through any attribute magic without regard for compatibility.
No Attribute might not be able to do what other attributes can.
But I wanted Krush to know that she has an attribute that makes her unbeatable.
"I never thought about it like that..."
Krush doesn't lack an attribute.
You possess an attribute that only you have.
So be proud.
Your No Attribute is strong.
I said what I needed to say. After that, I wasn't sure how Krush would feel.
With the knowledge of their attributes, I just needed to think of strategies for future battles.
Still, Krush had a slightly brighter expression. She was only eighteen. She would continue to learn and grow.
There would be many worries ahead, but I wanted to teach her what she didn't know and help her when she was troubled.
"We're almost at the place where the Dragon Zombie was discovered!"
After resuming our progress for a while, May informed us that we were nearing our destination.
Indeed, when we arrived at a place where the miasma was thick enough to overflow, orc zombies and goblin zombies were wandering around.
We couldn't take on all of them, or our magic power would run out.
However, looking at Krush's expression, she seemed filled with confidence.
Having learned about the potential of No Attribute, she seemed eager to test it out.
While not as powerful as Holy Attribute, No Attribute could also handle undead zombies.
Even if May couldn't defeat them, as long as she could buy time and support Krush, the three of us could manage.
"Both of you, take the lead."
"Leave it to me."
"Yes, I will!"
Watching the two fight, it seemed I could trust them to handle it.
Having spent more time with Krush, I noticed many things about her.
When we first met, she had always been hesitant with her sword, claiming she didn't know "love."
But after Lady Rana told her not to rush into knowing
"love,
" and she learned that No Attribute had no weaknesses, she now wielded her sword with confidence.
Her swordsmanship, now free of hesitation, was sharp, and the slow movements of the orc zombies couldn't catch her.
The strongest swordswoman of the Fourth Knight Order had awakened.
"Good job."
I entrusted the lead to the two and moved ahead.
Ahead lay a decaying Dragon Zombie, rising and dripping blood and flesh.
The miasma must have caused the death attribute to manifest in the dragon.
It's unfortunate that you, who were peacefully sleeping, have turned into a zombie.
However, right now, you are nothing but bones.
Allow me to help you sleep peacefully once more.
The miasma was so thick that breathing became difficult.
[imghttps://i.imgur.com/V0OlAPR.jpeg
Even I, with my Holy Attribute, could barely stand.
The monsters had been turned into zombies by this miasma, and it had spread to villages far away, contaminating all of Corias.
This Dragon Zombie must have been the root of that contamination.
The only thing I can do is put you to sleep. 《Holy Magic: Superior Exorcism Magic, Kyrie Eleison!》 Servants of death!
Release your bindings and vanish with the power of purification!
"GYAAAAA!"
As I began my incantation, the Dragon Zombie's eyes glowed ominously, and it roared, as if sensing danger.
I hadn't expected it to move before I could activate my spell. However, I couldn't move.
If I stopped the incantation now, I wouldn't be able to destroy the Dragon Zombie.
I needed to expend most of my magic power to eliminate such a massive miasma with this spell.
"Lord Salt! I am your dedicated knight! I will protect you, so please continue!"
Krush stood in front of me, trying to shield me from the rising Dragon Zombie.
In the dense miasma, Krush, who did not possess a Holy Attribute, was being eroded with every breath she took.
Don't stop the incantation.
You are my only hope.
If you can purify the Dragon Zombie, you can save those sisters too!
Trust me and continue the incantation!
"I'm here too! Leave the back to me!"
May realized she couldn't approach the miasma and was creating a wall with wind to keep the approaching orc zombies at bay.
While she couldn't defeat them, it was a clever way to stall them.
"Come on, Dragon Zombie! I am your opponent! As a knight, I will absolutely protect Lord Salt!"
There was no knight more reliable than this. More than anything, she was now wielding her power for someone else.
That was the true essence of a knight, a state of being that could not be reached without "love."
Krush might be doing this unconsciously, but with her back, which was larger than one would expect from a woman, she was protecting me, standing between me and the enemy.
How reassuring that was.
"GYAAAAAAAA!"
As my Holy Attribute began to purify the miasma, the Dragon Zombie thrashed about, trying to escape its suffering, swiping its claws.
"I told you, didn't I? I will protect Lord Salt. I won't let you do anything!"
Krush, enveloped in No Attribute magic, deflected the Dragon Zombie's claws with her shield and slashed at it with her sword.
The sight was like that of a hero battling a dragon. As a knight, she stood at the pinnacle.
"Ugh!"
Even so, the Dragon Zombie was strong.
While she could deflect its attacks with her No Attribute magic, she couldn't completely defeat it.
Purification was out of the question.
"Ugh!"
The Dragon Zombie's claws tore at Krush's clothes, blood splattering.
Her white skin was exposed, and I wanted to finish my incantation faster.
But there were still 20 seconds, 15 seconds, 10 seconds...
"Ugh! I won't lose!"
Krush stood up, blocking the Dragon Zombie's fangs with her sword.
"《Kyrie Eleison!》"
A vast bluish-white light surged forth, enveloping the Dragon Zombie.
It eliminated all the miasma and purified it.
By the time the light of the superior Holy magic faded, all the approaching orc zombies had also been purified, and the suffocating air had improved.
"Lord Salt!"
"Thank you, Krush! It's all thanks to you!"
Krush turned to me, her clothes torn by the Dragon Zombie, rushing over in a state of undress.
Her hidden curves swayed as she hugged me.
Breasts...?
Breasts...?
Wait, where's her bra!?
It's fine!
This is just the aftermath of battle!
Did I lose consciousness from magic exhaustion, or was it because I was embraced by Krush's beautiful naked form?
Either way, I defeated the Dragon Zombie and lost consciousness.
In my dream, I wondered how she maintained such fair skin while being in the Knight Order. No! What am I thinking?
"Lord Salt, have you awakened?"
"Huh?"
I recalled a similar incident before.
That time, I had woken up on Krush's lap while being jostled in a carriage.
"What?!"
When I opened my eyes, I found Krush in a dress shirt, giving me a lap pillow, and I was taken aback by her beautiful face.
As I slowly sat up, I felt the softness of her thighs.
"Um, thank you."
"Ah, you did well. Please rest slowly."
"Oh, no, I'm fine now. I just ran out of magic power."
"Is that so? For Lord Salt, I would gladly offer my body as much as needed."
Please stop saying such outrageous things while tilting your head cutely.
"Lord Salt! You've awakened!"
As I was distracted by Krush, May hugged me from behind.
With the momentum of her rocket breasts enveloping my head, I dove right into the chest of the dress-shirt-wearing Krush in front of me.
Front door dress-shirt big breasts! Back door rocket breasts! I could die happy!
Overwhelmed with happiness, I almost lost consciousness again from suffocation, but I managed to keep my awareness.
Wasn't the distance between May and Krush too close?
I understood they were happy to have defeated the monsters, but I was still a man, and it was troubling.
"Once again, Lord Salt, you did it!"
Please stop looking up at me with a happy face while holding my hand!
She was only wearing the robe I had brought as a spare over her dress shirt, and just trying to look at Krush's face made me catch a glimpse of her cleavage...
"Krush! Are you hurt?!"
While I had been thinking foolish thoughts, I became concerned about Krush's injuries from standing in front of me against the Dragon Zombie.
I wanted to check for wounds by taking off her clothes, but I couldn't do something like that.
"Huh? Oh, this is just a scratch."
No, that's not good.
We need to purify it properly.
May, come over here.
After fighting a death attribute monster, there's a risk of miasma lingering and eroding your body.
I'll cast Holy Magic on both of you.
"Understood!"
Lady Rana's cursed poison was a good example.
If Krush and May had been exposed to such dense miasma, monsters might make a nest inside them.
I carefully applied Holy Attribute magic for purification.
After finishing with Krush, I turned my gaze to May and froze.
As I moved in front of her, I noticed that her already light clothing had been torn during the fierce battle with the orc zombies, exposing her legs and abdomen.
Damn!
While I had been focused on the rocket breasts, I had overlooked the fact that the petite and cute May was showing off her underwear.
"《Heal!》"
As I cast the healing magic, the bluish-white light of the Holy Attribute enveloped her.
"Ahh... Hya... Nkuh..."
Damn, the sight that opened before my eyes was accompanied by an alluring voice...
It was the same with Asha and Cynthia.
When I cast healing magic, they would make strange sounds, perhaps because it felt good.
"Hah... It feels so good!"
"Ahh! Ugh! As a knight, I must endure!"
Hearing their voices made me feel strange, but I forced myself not to open my eyes and waited for the treatment to finish.
"Hah hah hah, huh? Why is Lord Salt keeping his eyes closed?"
"Hah hah hah, Lady Krush. That's because as a man, I don't want to see your soft skin."
"Soft skin? Hahh!"
Thanks to May's comment, Krush seemed to realize that her chest was exposed.
The Krush who had claimed she had no shame now subtly covered her chest, indicating some change in her heart.
However, Krush wasn't the only one whose clothing was disheveled. I handed a spare robe to May as well.
"Huh? Me?"
"Your pants are torn too, May. Wrap it around your waist."
"Hehe, so you see me as a woman too, Lord Salt!"
Why is she happy about that?
Regardless, I felt guilty for having caught a glimpse of the two of them in such a state, but I steeled myself.
"There should be a change of clothes in the carriage."
"That's right. I'll go to the carriage, Lord Salt."
"Ah, understood."
With the purification and treatment completed, the two of them energetically descended the rocky mountain.
The rocky mountain, now free of miasma and zombies, was peaceful.
At the summit where the two had descended, I headed toward the place where the Dragon Zombie had vanished.
There lay the bones of the dragon and a black magic stone left behind.
"What is this black magic stone?"
Magic stones are usually red, like blood.
However, the magic stone from the Dragon Zombie was dyed pitch black.
I felt an ominous sensation from the cursed magic stone.
"Should I purify this too?"
I unleashed Holy Magic, and the black magic stone was enveloped in bluish-white light, returning to a beautiful shining red magic stone.
"Was this also stained by the miasma?"
Had it been darkened by the miasma? However, Dragon Zombies don't occur naturally.
If a dragon dies in a place overflowing with miasma, it can become a Dragon Zombie.
However, this rocky mountain, where the Dragon Zombie had appeared, was not a place where a dragon should have made a nest and met its end.
Dragons are noble creatures and have a habit of making nests.
Therefore, when they approach death, they hide their bodies and treasures in their nests so that other creatures do not discover their demise, causing the nest to vanish entirely.
Yet, it was rare for a dragon to die in a place where anyone could find it.
That's why it felt unnatural.
Had someone intentionally brought the dragon's corpse to this miasma-infested place?
Or had the dragon died here due to an unfortunate accident?
Either way, this Dragon Zombie had met an inexplicable end.
"Lord Salt! I've finished changing!"
"Lord Salt! I'm sorry for leaving the investigation to you."
The two returned, dressed in the uniforms of the Fourth Knight Order that had been kept aside.
Still holding onto my questions, I showed them the red magic stone and announced that the investigation was complete.
The purification of this place was already finished, and there was no reason to linger any longer.
Even if this was something man-made, there were no signs to indicate it.
Yet, I couldn't shake the feeling of unease regarding the blackened magic stone.
